result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a misspelled search placeholder, and a promo banner that clips the last category pill.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off so the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' and the third card is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Give cards consistent width/padding or allow the row to scroll fully so names and images are not clipped.

issues.description: Search placeholder is misspelled as 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right; 'Healthy' is cut and the next chip is only a sliver.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll affordance or reduce chip padding so all filters are fully visible.

issues.description: The green promo banner overlaps/clips the category chips above it, hiding part of the last visible filter.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing between the filter row and banner so chips are not covered.
